technical.summary: Extreme oversold conditions on short-term oscillators conflict with bearish momentum signals and price structure; long-term trend support exists but lacks near-term confirmation for swing entry.

fundamental.summary: WEC shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and elevated earnings risk in 91 days—insufficient fundamental or smart money support for a bullish thesis.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (18/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but stale congressional sales (460 days old) and absent news data limit conviction.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis (432.8), flat yield curve, rising dollar, and imminent FOMC event create severely unfavourable macro conditions despite low near-term earnings risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Long-term trend structure (EMA 50/200 and SMA 50/200 bullish) combined with extreme oversold oscillators (RSI 9 at 13.22, Stoch K at 10.17) and contrarian fear sentiment (18/100) create a classic capitulation setup near support at 85.28.
debate.key_bear_argument: Bearish momentum confirmation across all short-term indicators (death cross active, MACD negative, CMF selling pressure, OBV not rising, three black crows pattern) combined with crisis-level VIX, unfavourable macro environment, imminent FOMC event, and zero fundamental/smart money support make this a trap for oversold bounces rather than a swing entry.

decision.entry_rationale: While extreme oversold conditions (RSI 9: 13.22, Stoch K: 10.17) and long-term trend support (EMA/SMA 50/200 bullish) present a contrarian setup, bearish momentum confirmation (death cross, MACD negative, CMF selling pressure, three black crows) and crisis-level macro conditions (VIX 432.8, imminent FOMC) create unacceptable risk/reward for swing entry.
decision.primary_risk: Macro crisis environment (extreme VIX, FOMC event imminent) and confirmed bearish momentum could drive further capitulation below support at 85.28 despite oversold oscillators, invalidating the contrarian thesis.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case despite contrarian oversold setup
decision.portfolio_note: Already holding WEC with 31 existing Utilities positions (20% of portfolio); sector concentration and existing ticker exposure further reduce conviction for marginal swing entry in hostile macro environment.
